messages:
nora: quick note  i'm opening a small docs PR to tighten up the 429 troubleshooting page. current page has long prose + two competing JS snippets; i'm going to replace with a tiny retry table, a curl example, and a single canonical JS snippet using the hosted SDK. will also fix a broken SDK anchor and add a CI linkcheck test. pushing in ~20m.
devin: sounds great. the retry table is a good ideacan you add explicit guidance for: honoring Retry-After, parsing seconds vs http-date, and a cap on retry delay? that saves support back-and-forth.
priya: +1 on a curl example. ops often send curl to customers. maybe show both header-first and fallback exponential backoff in curl (with sleep) so it's clear.
nora: plan: add a 3-row table (Retry-After present -> use header; no header -> capped exp backoff with jitter; persistent 429 -> escalate to rate-limits playbook), a compact JS snippet with exact SDK call, and a curl snippet showing how to check headers and wait. also will add a short "when to use model variant vs quantized fallback" note under fallbacks.
rahul: can you include the exact SDK param names we use in hosted examples? e.g. `retry: { maxRetries: 3, baseMs: 250, capMs: 5000, jitter: true }`. folks copy those verbatim.
doc-bot: linkcheck: broken link detected in error-reference/429.md -> "/docs/sdk/retries-old" returns 404 (reported 2h ago)
nora: fixed the link to `/docs/sdk/retries-guide#quick-config` in the draft. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1713
mike: LGTm for content. one tiny ask: add a unit step in CI that runs the markdown linkchecker against the file and the anchor. CI flaked on this last time because nav refactor moved anchors.
priya: for the curl example maybe show how to parse Retry-After seconds vs date with a short POSIX-friendly snippet: `retry_after_ms=$(date -d "$hdr" +%s) ...` or call out that servers may send a number of seconds. but keep it short.
devin: also add a one-line runtime cross-ref: "runtime trims input to fit model limits before fallback selection" — this explains why some fallbacks never see full prompt. linking that to runtime/faq will reduce tickets.
nora: added runtime FAQ cross-ref and a changelog entry in the PR. pushed the curl+js table+SDK snippet and the CI linkcheck tweak. assigning @priya for review.
priya: quick pass done, left one tiny grammar nit and asked CI to re-run. once green i'll merge and post a 2-line note to #support and #runtime. :thumbsup:
nora: thanks everyone  will post after merge.
